title: List each floor key and department name within the Stata building, as well
question: List each floor key and department name within the Stata building, as well as the number of rooms, total area, and average area per department on each floor. Include subtotals for each floor and a grand total across all floors. Sort the results by floor key and department name in ascending order. Exclude departments without any rooms in the building. Only the first row of each floor group should include the floor key, and the subtotal and grand total rows should not include floor key or department name. Number of rooms and area should be rounded to integers and formatted using commas as thousands separators.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY,
    o.ORGANIZATION_NAME,
    COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area
  FROM FCLT_ROOMS r
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME = 'STATA CENTER'
    AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.FCLT_FLOOR_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME
),
floor_sub AS (
  SELECT
    FCLT_FLOOR_KEY,
    SUM(num_rooms) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area
  FROM base
  GROUP BY FCLT_FLOOR_KEY
),
grand AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(num_rooms) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(total_area) AS total_area
  FROM base

SELECT
  CASE WHEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) = 1 THEN FCLT_FLOOR_KEY ELSE NULL END AS FLOOR_KEY,

  FORMAT(ROUND(total_area), 0),
  FORMAT(ROUND(total_area / num_rooms), 0)

UNION ALL
SELECT

  SELECT
    f.FLOOR AS floor_key,
    d.DLC_NAME AS department_name,
    COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS num_rooms,
    SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area,
    AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area
  FROM FCLT_FLOOR f

  JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY
  JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY d ON o.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY
  JOIN FCLT_BUILDING b ON f.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = b.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
  WHERE b.BUILDING_NAME = 'STATA CENTER'
  GROUP BY f.FLOOR, d.DLC_NAME
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(floor_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN NULL
    WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN NULL
    ELSE floor_key
  END AS floor_key,
  CASE
    WHEN GROUPING(floor_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL'
    WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL'
    ELSE department_name
  END AS department_name,
  FORMAT(SUM(num_rooms), 0) AS num_rooms,
  FORMAT(SUM(total_area), 0) AS total_area,
  FORMAT(AVG(avg_area), 0) AS avg_area
FROM base
GROUP BY floor_key, department_name
WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN GROUPING(floor_key) = 1 AND GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 2
       WHEN GROUPING(department_name) = 1 THEN 1
       ELSE 0 END,
  floor_key,
  department_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ORGANIZATION_ID, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MAX(t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS t0 JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN `HR_ORG_UNIT` AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IS NULL AND NOT t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID IS NULL AND t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT t1.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')), DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, STDDEV(r.AREA) AS area_stddev FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS') AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 5), DepartmentRoomCount AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS total_room_count FROM `FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY` AS d JOIN `FCLT_ORGANIZATION` AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN `FCLT_ROOMS` AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o1.ORGANIZATION_ID, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, o1.MAX_HR_ORG_UNIT_ID, d2.area_stddev, d3.total_room_count FROM inner_cte AS o1 LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomAreaStddev AS d2 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d2.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN DepartmentRoomCount AS d3 ON o1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = d3.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY o1.ORGANIZATION_ID
